native.method: Continuing user-authorized isolated localhost Chromium QA. Actual keyboard/select/button actions and read-only camera/mesh/pose observations. Raw JPEGs; desktop and 390px mobile. Only cat refinement is tested; G, feeding, GLB and controlled context recovery are not rerun. No hardware performance claim.

scope: Refined cat silhouette, lower-contrast irregular procedural tabby, shoulder-pivot sitting, distance-driven sagittal IK gait and stable foreground camera containing real 3D garden context. No rerun of native G/feed/GLB/context-recovery flows. Existing automated regression remains covered; earlier native records retain their own bundle.
limitations: Fixed dry route; no arbitrary-terrain pathfinding or full-body dynamics.
Straight steady stance cancels forward displacement; curved contact is approximate, not exact world-space paw planting.
No fur simulation or photorealism acceptance, hardware-performance or GPU-memory measurements.
